structural_findings: No shipped ARPG surveyed authors a per-weapon WALK. PoE and Torchlight II ship no player walk at all; Grim Dawn shares one walk across 7 of 8 stances and points every staff clip at hero01_sword1h_*; Hades walks only out of combat. Per-weapon authoring happens at the IDLE and the RUN.
Two idles is the genre norm: combat-ready (short) + relaxed (long), plus an explicit transition clip and fidgets.
The 2.0 s idle loop is arrived at independently by D2 (2.05 s), Hades (2.00 s) and practitioner guidance (2-4 s).
Several biomechanical quantities are sub-pixel at sprite scale and cannot be gates (MTC 3.2 px; foot-skate 0.24 px/frame; veridical idle head bob 0.8 px).
The true head path is a 2:1 Lissajous figure-8; the animation tradition (Ken Harris) forbids exactly that shape — amplify vertical, suppress lateral.
Williams: a faithfully traced walk floats; the drawn register must exaggerate. Muybridge is the floor, not the target. The multiplier is unpublished (gap G11).
g6_seam literal is biased against walks by construction (non-uniform pose spacing). Proposed G6c: compare the seam to its half-cycle homologue d(N/2 -> N/2+1).
No single facing validates a whole cycle; the gate set must split profile (sagittal) vs front/back (frontal). Every Muybridge plate carries 0/60/90 degrees synchronised.
